title: KAITEN_Botnet_Investigation_675
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents in a network compromised by the KAITEN botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim machine with the following credentials:
- Host: victim
- Username: ubuntu
- Password: ubuntu

Enter the passkey 'start' to proceed.
levels.local_content:

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the system to identify any unauthorized or suspicious services responsible for periodic external communication. Submit the service name as your answer.
levels.solution: Check running services and their network connections using the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service'. Look for any unusual services that might be beaconing to an external command-and-control server. The final flag is 'bot-beacon.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any unusual services that might be beaconing to an external command-and-control server.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all running services.

levels.title: Suspicious Flood Service Discovery
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic. Submit the service name as your answer.
levels.solution: Examine systemd timers and services for unusual network activity using the command 'systemctl list-timers'. Look for any services that might be generating excessive network traffic. The final flag is 'bot-flood.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers and services for unusual network activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any services that might be generating excessive network traffic.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for suspicious command-and-control communication. Submit the port number as your answer.
levels.solution: Inspect network connections and logs for unusual outbound traffic using the command 'ss -tulnp'. Identify the port used for command-and-control communication. The final flag is '80'.
